pages.title: A letter to Canada · 1/3
paragraphs: It is lunchtime at a small post office in Tampa. A line of people waits near the counter. Gil holds a letter and a brown box. He is going to send them to his sister. A clerk named Nora waves to him. It is his turn.
“Next, please. How can I help you?” says Nora. “I need a stamp for this letter, please.” says Gil. “Where is it going?” says Nora.
